item.title: HENDERSON COUNTY SECURES $425K STATE GRANT TO BOOST FARMLAND PRESERVATION FUND
item.description: As development continues to expand across western North Carolina, Henderson County leaders are taking steps to protect local farmland. County officials recently secured a $425,000 grant from the North Carolina Department of Agriculture and Consumer Services to help preserve agricultural land. item.title: AFTER 18 MONTH CLOSURE DUE TO HELENE REBUILT HENDERSONVILLE FRESH MARKET OPENS
item.description: A popular Hendersonville grocery store is making a comeback after being closed for 18 months due to Helene. The Fresh Market is finally reopening its doors, this time with a fresh look and more space for shoppers. The store was heavily damaged when floodwaters filled the building during the storm, forcing crews to gut the entire interior. item.title: BLUE RIDGE HUMANE SOCIETY BUYS MILLS RIVER PROPERTY FOR FUTURE ADOPTION CENTER
item.description: The Blue Ridge Humane Society has purchased property at 823 Banner Farm Road in Mills River to help secure the future of animal welfare in Henderson County. According to a news release, the purchase of the property will allow the Blue Ridge Humane Society to expand community programs. The property will also become the future home of the organization's Adoption Center.
